property_summary: In the reference C, a successful setL1BlockValues call never changes any state, so c.sequenceNumber() stays 0 for every input; the mutant stores _sequenceNumber, so for some input sequenceNumber() returns a nonzero value, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Insert `sequenceNumber = _sequenceNumber;` after the require so the public getter sequenceNumber() returns the passed value.
